parameters.content:
06_Daily_Backup — daily 03:00 backup + keep only latest cycle

ACTIVE (no n8n API key needed):
  Daily 03:00 -> Config -> Seed Snapshots (embedded 01-06 -> importable .json)
    -> Upload Workflow Files -> 03_Backup
  Daily 03:00 -> Config -> Download Media Sheet (.xlsx, all tabs incl. Logs)
    -> Upload Media Backup -> 03_Backup
  join -> List Backup Files -> Find Old Cycle Files -> Delete Old Backup
  (keeps ONLY the latest cycle)

SEED note: Seed Snapshots holds base64 snapshots of 01-06 captured at build
time. It re-uploads the SAME snapshot each day (workflow definitions do not
change daily). The Media .xlsx branch IS a true live daily backup.

SWITCH TO LIVE (after adding an n8n API key):
  1) enable Get Workflows + Build Workflow Files
  2) rewire Config -> Get Workflows -> Build Workflow Files -> Upload Workflow Files
  3) disable Seed Snapshots
  Then 01-06 (and any future 07_) are exported live every day.

RESTORE: download the dated .json from 03_Backup -> n8n Workflows menu ->
Import from File. Media: download the dated .xlsx -> Google Sheets File -> Import.

parameters.jsCode:
const SNAPSHOTS = [
  { name: "01_Ingestion Source", b64: '' },
  { name: "02_Document_Pipeline", b64: '' },
  { name: "03_YouTube_Pipeline", b64: '' },
  { name: "04_RAG_Chat", b64: '' },
  { name: "05_Error_Logs", b64: '' },
  { name: "06_Daily_Backup", b64: '' },
];

// --- decode embedded snapshots into importable workflow files ---
const date = $('Config').first().json.backup_date;
const out = [];
for (const s of SNAPSHOTS) {
  const jsonStr = Buffer.from(s.b64, 'base64').toString('utf8');
  const safe = s.name.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '_');
  const fileName = `${date}__${safe}.json`;
  out.push({
    json: { fileName, workflow_name: s.name, source: 'seed_snapshot' },
    binary: { data: await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(Buffer.from(jsonStr, 'utf8'), fileName, 'application/json') },
  });
}
if (out.length === 0) throw new Error('No seed snapshots to back up');
return out;
